result.title: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
result.summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient generation, yet maintaining consistency over long rollouts remains challenging, especially when subjects or scenes reappear after going out of sight. Despite progress in fidelity and rollout robustness, existing distillation methods do not fully exploit richer historical information to constrain the student's current prediction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{History Forcing}, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision. Such a historical context can be obtained using earlier generated chunks with less accumulated drift or a fixed-view teacher rollout that keeps the scene visible while the student looks away. The residual is then weighted and added to the score or velocity prediction used for distillation, forming a corrected target. By aligning the student with this corrected target through distillation, History Forcing incorporates long-range historical constraints into autoregressive generation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among 1.3B models, with a VBench quality score of 85.07 for 15s video generation and a VBench-Long aggregate score of 79.82 for 60s generation. For out-of-sight world modeling, evaluations further demonstrate more plausible scene evolution and more consistent states when the camera returns, with Evolution Quality improving from 2.35 to 2.70 on PlayWorld and Object Consistency from 58.43 to 62.18 on MemoBench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 History Forcing，一种 on-policy 蒸馏框架：用「有/无信息性历史上下文」的教师预测残差解耦历史监督，加权后修正 score/velocity 预测作为蒸馏目标，使少步自回归视频扩散模型在长时序生成中维持一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以「有/无上下文」的教师差分来量化历史信息贡献并写入训练目标，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的贡献分配与 latent 监督提供可核查线索；但论文本身针对视频世界模型生成，非多模态推理。
